source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on linux, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Stereo multimode filter (low-, high-, band-pass, notch, comb) with 12 or 24 dB/oct slopes, pre-filter drive, an LFO (free or tempo-synced) and stereo phase offset. For sweeps, wah and auto-filter, and comb resonance.
quirks: At the defaults it is a 2 kHz low-pass: it cuts the highs (−9.5 dB on noise in the profile).
In Comb mode Cutoff is the comb's fundamental and Resonance its feedback; Slope then picks FIR (flanging) or IIR (resonator).
Every parameter at its maximum at once is hot (+16 dBFS); no single parameter is.
evidence: ExternalMachines/source/thepedal/pedal-filter/PedalFilter.cs — scaling in Work (cutoff in Hz, drive gain, LFO rate and depth)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, linux 2026-11-03) — filter, 3 samples latency, −9.5 dB at the defaults

problems: hot with every parameter at its maximum at once (+16.0 dBFS peak), but with no parameter alone

swept_because: every parameter at its maximum at once: hot

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Low pass, high pass, band pass, band reject (notch) or comb.

parameters.name: Slope
parameters.description: 12 dB/oct (2-pole) or 24 dB/oct (4-pole); for Comb, FIR or IIR.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: 0% wide to 100% near self-oscillation; comb feedback in Comb mode.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Gain into a tanh saturator before the filter, 1× (clean) to 10×.

parameters.name: LFO Wave
parameters.description: Sine, triangle, square, saw up, saw down or sample and hold.

parameters.name: Tempo Sync
parameters.description: Locks the LFO to the song tempo, at LFO Div.

parameters.name: LFO Div
parameters.description: LFO cycle with Tempo Sync on: 4 bars down to 1/16 triplets.

parameters.name: LFO Depth
parameters.description: Sweep around the cutoff, up to ±4 octaves.

parameters.name: Phase Offset
parameters.description: LFO phase difference between left and right in degrees: 0 mono, 90 quadrature, 180 opposed.
